name: cadre-lifecycle-github
description: GitHub-flavored Agentic SDLC gate-approval recording: a conversational skill that records lifecycle gate decisions from a real GitHub PR review via approve-from-github/approve-from-github-pr. Requires cadre-lifecycle-core to also be installed. If you don't have a GitHub review to cite, cadre-lifecycle-core's generic lifecycle-review skill covers that case.

interface.shortDescription: Record Agentic SDLC gate decisions from a real GitHub PR review.
interface.longDescription: Conversationally record a lifecycle gate decision sourced from an actual GitHub pull request review, via approve-from-github/approve-from-github-pr. Requires cadre-lifecycle-core.
defaultPrompt: Use lifecycle-review-github to record a gate decision from a GitHub PR review.
